input_modality: text only (instructions + compact state string); no images, no audio
retry_policy: network/timeout errors, HTTP 429, HTTP 5xx only; exponential backoff 1s*2^n + U(0,0.25)s jitter; 4xx never retried

failure_policy.refusal: a refusal output item is not a failure: every question becomes a 'refusal' answer and the frozen P1 refusal path applies (unknown decision, risk midpoint 0.5 flagged, confidence 0.0, human review forced); recorded as refusal
failure_policy.incomplete: status=incomplete (max_output_tokens / content_filter) -> item recorded as FAILED, no result file, no retry
failure_policy.schema_parse_failure: output not valid JSON or not valid against the strict schema -> item recorded as FAILED, no result file, no retry
failure_policy.transport: network / 429 / 5xx after 2 retries -> item recorded as FAILED

pricing.reasoning_tokens_billing: billed as output tokens (included in output_tokens)
pricing.pricing_source: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-6.1-sol (Standard: Input $2, Cached input $0.1, Cache writes $2.5, Output $10 per 1M tokens)

latency_note: state -> GPT API -> adapter (cached frozen state); not full E2E; single primary call, not a controlled repeated benchmark
estimated_cost_usd_note: null in results: local CV compute cost not measured; external_api_cost_usd recorded separately
